name: synthetic-beacons-pit
notes: AC-M1-07 / D-075, D-132: >= 15 s below 1 km/h of Corr Speed (fastest of the front wheels, clamped at 0) inside a lap sets only pitStop (class, number and trust unchanged); after a pit stop the next lap starts a new stint unless the car had not moved yet; a lap counter decrease starts a stint; beacon intervals never do
source: synthetic: four wheel speeds and a lap counter with BCN beacons; a 20 s wait in the pit box before the out lap, a 10 s stop in Lap 1, a 20 s pit stop in Lap 2, a counter reset in Lap 3, a locking front-left wheel and front wheels reading below zero while stationary
